name: Implement Mouse Direction Controller
instruction: Update scripts/player.gd so the Player CharacterBody2D reads the local mouse vector each physics frame, snaps the angle to 45-degree steps, wraps it into the 0-7 range, and plays the matching AnimatedSprite2D animation with the angle appended (e.g., idle0, idle1, etc.). When left_mouse is held and the mouse distance exceeds 10 pixels, switch to run animations (e.g., run0, run1, etc.) and move with move_and_slide() toward the mouse; otherwise, stay on idle animations with zero velocity.

metadata.transcript_excerpt: To choose which animation to play, we need to get the mouse direction and map it to this same range of 0-7 ... snappedf(mouse.angle(), PI/4) .... Finally, we need to map the resulting range to 0-7 using the wrapi() function ... Adding that value to the end of the animation name gives us the correct animation.

key_properties.player.gd._physics_process: Snaps get_local_mouse_position angle to PI/4, wrapi to 0-7, sets velocity toward mouse when left_mouse pressed, and plays idle/run animations
